brand.note: Existing product branding is retained; aliases do not rename the application.

positioning: A sign-in CV builder with free clean Color and Plain PDF downloads and local document-to-profile field-mapping assistance.

freeCv.quotaNote: No numerical daily quota was found in the direct browser PDF path. This is not an unlimited-service promise. Device resources and input limits apply.

documentReader.processing: On-device PDF text extraction, OCR and heuristic field proposals; OCR resources may need network downloads.
acceptedInputs: supported images including PNG and JPEG
plain text including TXT, Markdown and CSV
documentReader.note: UI translation support does not establish multilingual OCR or full-document scanned-PDF processing.

availableWorkflow: propose profile values from document text
formAssistance.note: Local field mapping is not a promise to submit external applications or write back into any uploaded PDF. Paid server credit APIs exist; the inspected local UI did not establish the completed paid-fill integration.

generativeAi.note: No active generative-model integration was established by the source audit. Do not advertise verified AI resume writing or unrestricted AI form automation.

paidCheckout.note: Paid form-filler plans exist in source, but public checkout was unavailable at the recorded observation. Legacy paid-export limits/prices are not free-PDF limits.

languages.note: Twelve locale-prefixed public content collections have request-scoped SSR. Existing editor UI remains eight locale IDs / seven base languages. Polish, Russian, German, Portuguese and Indonesian public pages explicitly open the English editor. English OCR and unverified Unicode PDF output coverage are separate capabilities. Catalogs have not received independent native-speaker review.

support.note: Email is published on the public services page; no email was sent and inbox existence/deliverability was not tested.

sitemap.note: Generated from twelve active public content collections and twelve existing English content routes, without query duplicates or fabricated lastmod. All localized catalogs are editorial drafts awaiting native-speaker review; this does not assert twelve-language editor/OCR/PDF output support.

discoveryNotice: These voluntary AI-readable assets do not guarantee discovery, crawling, indexing, retrieval, citation, ranking or recommendation. They are not a special Google ranking requirement.

evidence.note: Public facts and source audit only. No customer records, credentials, payment or authenticated production E2E tests used.
